notes.title: Élan Vital now for sale!
notes.content:
The first release by Camisade Projects, Élan Vital, is now for sale! Join in celebrating the first of several releases and watch as our projects grow and improve. 

Adventure alongside Liam in his journey to uncover the circumstances regarding "the pulse" in this tale of one man's quest for truth. Will he find the answer he is looking for or is there more behind the downfall of society than meets the eye?

Questions? Comments? Just want to say hi? You can always email us through our [url=https://camisadeprojects.carrd.co/]site[/url]. Don't forget to leave a review, your feedback is invaluable to us.
